# Mikhail Semenov, Product Manager

> Product manager in B2B SaaS, 4.5 years. Open to work, can start immediately, no notice period. At Zvonobot (Prof-IT Group), February 2022 to October 2026, launched a voice AI agent line from scratch in October 2025: 80 paying B2B customers and 500,000+ minutes of live conversations in production in under a year. Remote, GMT+5, open to relocation.

## Profile
- Title: Product Manager (B2B SaaS, voice AI agents, LLM)
- Status: open to work, can start immediately, no notice period
- Looking for: Product Manager or Product Owner roles on a product team, in B2B SaaS, AI and LLM products, payments and billing, telecom and CPaaS, or infrastructure platforms with integrations and APIs; full-time or contract
- Location and format: remote, GMT+5; open to relocation
- Languages: Russian (native); English B2, working correspondence and documentation daily, confident on work calls

## Zvonobot AI, October 2025 to October 2026
- Launched from scratch: a white-label platform first, to prove demand with live customers; then the case, made with numbers, for an in-house and more flexible platform, and the move of the line onto it
- 80 paying B2B customers and 500,000+ minutes of live conversations in production by August 2026, in under a year from launch
- 30% of line revenue came from repeat purchases
- +30% average spend: customers on AI agents versus customers on the legacy linear IVR robot, which became the basis for pricing
- Full product suite of the line: agent and script builder, LLM call analytics, per-second billing plans by cost component (LLM, ASR, TTS), balance hold at campaign start
- Owned pricing, per-call-type margins, unit economics and go-to-market with sales, support and finance; the sales team grew from 4 to 15 people to sell the line
- Team of 4 engineers: engineering reported to the tech lead, while priorities, specs and acceptance were mine; set quarterly OKRs for the line

## Zvonobot core platform, 2022-2025
- The core B2B SaaS platform end to end: self-service customer console, campaign creation and lead-list targeting, script builder, telephony, per-second billing, wallets, reporting and call analytics
- CPaaS products of the group in 130+ countries (bulk calls and SMS): ran Effebot (Zvonobot's international brand) and P1SMS, with traffic routing across providers, billing and API integrations
- A virtual PBX launched as a complementary product to raise customer retention
- A full discovery and delivery loop: customer interviews, hypotheses tested on metrics, A/B tests of call scripts, PRDs, and a release cycle run with sales, support and engineering
- A voice bot MVP on the OpenAI Realtime API in 2 days, and an internal analytics tool over the database in 4 days

## Case studies
- [Zvonobot AI: voice AI agent platform for B2B](https://rebsem.ru/projects/zvonobot-ai-en/): the line launched from scratch in October 2025, 80 paying B2B customers in under a year
- [Obrabot: internal workspace for the voice AI team at Prof-IT](https://rebsem.ru/projects/obrabot-en/): internal prompt registry, proposal generator and LLM call analytics, in production; owned as the PM until October 2026
- [Cursivo: AI agent and CRM for car rental teams](https://rebsem.ru/projects/cursivo-en/): own product in development, no public release and no users yet (product site: https://cursivo.xyz)
- [BazaBot: Telegram bot for cleaning client bases](https://rebsem.ru/projects/bazabot-en/): contact base cleanup for SMS and calling campaigns, built and shipped in one day
- [Zodial: personalized PDF report platform](https://rebsem.ru/projects/zodial-en/): payments, computation, PDF and email with no human in the loop, built in 3 days
- [Slopiq: iOS app for ski and snowboard sessions](https://rebsem.ru/projects/slopiq-en/): personal SwiftUI app, from idea to a working build in 7 days
- [Portfo: this site](https://rebsem.ru/projects/portfo-en/): this hiring site, built in 3 days and open source
